text:
Hi Riley,

Welcome to the Design Intern team at Larkspur Studio! Following your two interviews last week, we're excited to have you start on June 3. Your laptop is company-provided: IT will ship a MacBook to your home at no cost, and you return it at the end of the internship. Your onboarding tasks are in our Workday portal; sign in with your Larkspur account.

Warmly,
Kai Brandt
People Team, Larkspur Studio
